what: plastic.manage_rules makes a rule from the Polypropylene library rule with a 1 degree draft and makes it active; a round rest with no draft of its own takes it
method: the new rule starts from Polypropylene (PP) (3 mm): thickness 3, nominal radius 0.5*Thickness = 1.5, thickness variation 0.15*Thickness = 0.45, clearance 0.1, min/max 0.8/3.8, its draft set to 1 deg. A solid round rest 10 across and 5 high drafted 1 deg: V = 60*40*3 + (pi*5/3)(5^2 + 5 r1 + r1^2), r1 = 5 - 5 tan 1 deg, = 7585.884376
